E6R3.notes: Primary E6(R3) text; loc grammar with annex prefix (P, GL, A1, A2, AppB, AppC). Annex 2 passages cross-checked in the EMA Step 5 Annex 2 copy (vendor/sources/E6R3-A2-EMA/doc_2.txt; proposed key E6R3-A2-EMA withdrawn by R1). EU effective dates: Principles and Annex 1 23 Jul 2025, Annex 2 15 Jan 2027 (EMA-E6R3). US: FDA guidance (FDA-E6R3, FDA-E6R3-A2).
E6R3.title: ICH E6(R3) Guideline for Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Final version, Step 4, consolidated with Annex 2

E8R1.notes: Sections 3.2-3.3 critical to quality factors read in full; S6 and S7 read. Alternative official URL ICH_E8-R1_Guideline_Step4_2021_1006.pdf not read. EU/US adoption not checked [verify binding].
